action_items: (Cosmetic) Render the proof field label literally as 'Proof (optional)' in RecoverySubmitDialog so users see the optional indicator (functionality already correct).
(A11y/Polish) Add a DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the recovery submit Radix DialogContent to silence the React warning and improve SR support.
(Polish) Ensure Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents have explicit min height to remove 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first mount of RecoveryIntelligence.
critical_code_review_comments: Recovery overview endpoint correctly slices last N days based on ?days and supports team filter; consider adding response caching (5-10s) for staff overview since it runs aggregations across all athletes - may matter as athlete count grows.

Multiple-submissions per day: ensure /api/recovery/today aggregation now uses SUM (not last) for repeated activity ids; verified empirically (300+25+25=350), but recommend a comment in the aggregation pipeline noting the deliberate non-dedupe semantics.

RecoveryIntelligence.js uses several useEffect data-fetches without dependency cleanup - if a user changes ri-team-filter or ri-days-filter rapidly, in-flight requests can race; consider AbortController to cancel stale fetches.

Readiness-radar bug fix: rely on demo-seeded data for 'today'. Add a backend safeguard so the endpoint never returns empty arrays for athletes_count>0 (return zero-vector entries instead) to keep the UI rendering predictable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all listed selectors and flows
